label: About
title: About Looking Turns the Room
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1230 recent saved-signal files and 852 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Anton Repponen found an award-winning photo project during a camera roll deep dive and Gideon Tsang’s blurred and distorted work is nature photography as you’ve never seen it before, plus 4 more. A source image from m.itsnicethat.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Looking Turns the Room: Cinematic still, eye-level oblique public-gallery view: a monumental lavender-gray picture plane turns leftward, separated from an anonymous ivory-shirted back across pale blue-gray wall. Displace its orange star canton and green-charcoal stripes toward the outer edge. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Perspective-skewed lavender painted surface with orange-and-green motif, Lower charcoal pigment island within the painting, and Dark strap junction at the bag's upper-left edge.
